about: Hosted-platform DNS fingerprints. CANONICAL copy (shopify-radar). Read by bulk_classify.py, ct_tail.py (CT_HOSTED_TAG) and — vendored as storepulse/scripts/lib/hosted-platforms.json — detect-builders.mjs. Bump `version` (YYYY-MM-DD) on every change: detect-builders re-checks rows it last checked before that date, and warns when the two copies differ. First match wins, top to bottom. kind=commerce: being on the platform makes it a store. kind=builder: most sites are brochures — a tag is NOT a store (builder-promote confirms commerce). CNAME suffixes match on a label boundary anywhere in the A answer's CNAME chain; cidr matches any A record (apex or www); domain_suffix matches the domain name itself. Only add an anchor with tested evidence; record it in `evidence`. Verification method (2026-11-13): live DNS (1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8, A answer incl. CNAME chain, apex + www) on stores whose platform came from an HTTP fingerprint (woo_probe_cms / crux-ranked / builtwith) — never from cms_dns, which would be circular — plus precision checks: domains from a 75,000-leaf CT sample (5 logs, 2026-11-13) that hit the anchor, fetched once over HTTP and grepped for the platform's own HTML marker. IP owners from Team Cymru ASN DNS.

platforms.name: Shopify
platforms.evidence: Pre-existing (ct_tail SHOPIFY_NETS). CT sample: 267/7,920 resolved candidates.

platforms.name: Wix
platforms.evidence: 185.230.60.0/22 = AS58182 wix_com. Known Wix (HTTP-labelled) 57/60 resolved: apex 185.230.63.107/.171/.186 or 23.236.62.147 (6/60); www CNAME cdn*.wixdns.net / cfd.wixdns.net. CT-sample precision: 185.230.6x hits 10/10 and 23.236.62.147 hits 10/10 carry parastorage/wixstatic. NOT used: Wix www edge 172.66.3.8 / 162.159.143.12 (shared Cloudflare).

platforms.name: Squarespace
platforms.evidence: Both /24s = AS53831 SQUARESPACE. Known Squarespace 60/60 resolved: 58/60 A in those /24s, www CNAME ext-cust/ext-sq.squarespace.com. NOT used: *.mysquarespace.com resolves to 13.248.169.48/76.223.54.146, which in CT are mostly parked/blank pages.

platforms.name: Webflow
platforms.evidence: Known Webflow 58/60: apex 198.202.211.1 (34) or 75.2.70.75+99.83.190.102 (14); www CNAME cdn.webflow.com / proxy-ssl(-geo-2).webflow.com. REMOVED 63.250.43.0/24 (was in bulk_classify): that is AS22612 NAMECHEAP shared hosting — 12/871 banked 'Webflow' rows resolve there and the 3 fetched are WordPress (wp-content), i.e. Woo candidates mislabelled Webflow.

platforms.name: BigCommerce
platforms.evidence: Both /24s = AS399566 BIGCOMMERCE. Known BigCommerce (HTTP-labelled) 12/20 resolve into them (www CNAME store-<hash>.mybigcommerce.com where set); the other 8 are orange-clouded Cloudflare (Samsonite ZA group) or migrated. CT-sample precision 5/7 carry 'bigcommerce' (other 2: a Catalyst sandbox + a 503, both BC infra).

Narrow pools on purpose — the surrounding KT ranges host unrelated sites.
